```{r  message = FALSE}
library(cmdstanr)

library(tidyverse)

multi_site_model <- cmdstan_model("stan/core_03_multisite_linear_pe_trend_Optimised.stan")

```

# Fitting each species individually

## Prepping Butterfly Data Bundle for Model

```{r}
make_multisite_butterfly_bundle <- function(data_df,
                                            prior_only = 0,
                                            slope_prior_sd = 0.5,
                                            sigma_site_scale = 0.35,
                                            sigma_period_scale = 0.15) {
  
  ## Check just one species
  if( length(unique( data_df$Sp)) !=1 ){stop('more than one species')}
  
  ## Enforce consistent ordering
  data_df %>%
    arrange(Site, YEAR) -> data_df
  
  ## Time IDs for each year
  years_in_data <- sort(unique(data_df$YEAR ))
  N_times =  length(years_in_data)
  data_df$time_id = as.integer(seq_len(N_times)[factor(data_df$YEAR)])
  
  ## Site IDs for each site 
  N_sites =  length(unique(data_df$Site ))
  data_df$site_id = as.integer(seq_len(N_sites)[factor(data_df$Site)])
  
  ## Year labelling based on START of motif (different to simulation!)
  x_range <- range(years_in_data)
  
  data_df$time_scaled = (data_df$YEAR - mean(x_range)) / diff(x_range)
  time_grid_scaled <-(years_in_data - mean(x_range)) / diff(x_range)
  
  ##   Build List
  stan_data <- list(N = nrow(data_df),
                    K = 6L,
                    S = N_sites,
                    G = N_times,
                    y = as.integer(data_df$Motif),
                    site = data_df$site_id,
                    time_id = data_df$time_id,
                    time_scaled = as.numeric(data_df$time_scaled),
                    time_grid_scaled = as.numeric(time_grid_scaled),
                    
                    #Prior Flag 
                    prior_only = as.integer(prior_only),
                    
                    ## Changeable Priors
                    slope_prior_sd = slope_prior_sd,
                    sigma_site_scale = sigma_site_scale,
                    sigma_period_scale = sigma_period_scale)
  
  ## Object Length Checkers
  stopifnot( length(stan_data$time_scaled) == stan_data$N,
             length(stan_data$time_grid_scaled) == stan_data$G,
             length(stan_data$y) == stan_data$N,
             length(stan_data$site) == stan_data$N,
             length(stan_data$time_id) == stan_data$N)
  
  return(stan_data)
  
}
```

# Fitting across species with LM embedded

```{R}
model_label <- "period_sd_08_O2"
```

## Function to save diagnostics and summary of key parameters

```{R}
save_multisite_pe_fit <- function(fit,
                                  species,
                                  model_label,
                                  stan_data,
                                  event_data,
                                  output_root = "Butterfly_fits") {
  species_folder <- gsub("/", "_", species)
  output_dir <- file.path(output_root, species_folder)
  dir.create(output_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
  
  output_file <- function(name) file.path(output_dir, paste0(model_label, "_", name))
  
  summary_variables <- c("alpha_nsb", "beta_time",
                         "sigma_site", "sigma_period",
                         "pe_population_time", "pe_period_time",
                         "pe_slope", "pe_intercept")
  
  draw_variables <- c("pe_slope", "pe_intercept")
  
  fit$summary(summary_variables) %>%
    write_csv(output_file("parameter_summary.csv"))
  
  fit$draws(draw_variables, format = "draws_df") %>%
    as.data.frame() %>%
    write_csv(output_file("pe_effect_draws.csv"))
  
  fit$summary( variables = "theta_period_time",
               "mean", "median", "sd", "q5" = ~quantile(.x, 0.05), "q95" = ~quantile(.x, 0.95)) %>%
    write_csv(output_file("inferred_motif_frequencies.csv"))
  
  
  diagnostics <- fit$diagnostic_summary(quiet = TRUE)
  
  tibble(num_divergent = sum(diagnostics$num_divergent),
         num_max_treedepth = sum(diagnostics$num_max_treedepth),
         min_ebfmi = min(diagnostics$ebfmi),
         ebfmi = paste(diagnostics$ebfmi, collapse = "; ")) %>%
    write_csv(output_file("sampler_diagnostics.csv"))
  
  event_data %>%
    distinct(YEAR) %>%
    arrange(YEAR) %>%
    mutate(time_id = row_number(),
           time_scaled = stan_data$time_grid_scaled) %>%
    write_csv(output_file("time_lookup.csv"))
  
  saveRDS( list( species = species,
                 model_label = model_label,
                 stan_data = stan_data,
                 fit_metadata = fit$metadata()),
           output_file("metadata.rds")
  )
}

```

# Fitting across species

```{r }
species_to_fit <- FullMotif_df %>%
  distinct(Sp) %>%
  arrange(Sp) %>%
  filter( !(Sp %in% c('Euphydryas aurinia' , 'Hamearis lucina',# outliers of low data (less than 500)
                      "Thymelicus sylvestris", "Thymelicus lineola")) )%>%  ## confusing skippers. (Keeping ,"Thymelicus lineola/sylvestris")
  pull(Sp)

fit_one_species <- function(species, i) {
  print(species)
  print(Sys.time())
  
  species_data <-  filter(FullMotif_df,
                          Sp == species)
  
  stan_data <- make_multisite_butterfly_bundle(data_df = species_data,
                                               slope_prior_sd = 0.5,
                                               sigma_site_scale = 0.35,
                                               sigma_period_scale = 0.8)
  
  fit <- multi_site_model$sample(data = stan_data,
                                 chains = 4,
                                 parallel_chains = 4,
                                 iter_warmup = 1000,
                                 iter_sampling = 1500,
                                 adapt_delta = 0.95,
                                 max_treedepth = 12,
                                 seed = 1 + i,
                                 refresh = 100)
  
  save_multisite_pe_fit(fit = fit,
                        species = species,
                        model_label = model_label,
                        stan_data = stan_data,
                        event_data = species_data,
                        output_root = "Butterfly_fits")
  invisible(gc())
  return(species)
}
```

### Fitting with error catcher

```{r eval = FALSE}
safe_fit_one_species <- safely(fit_one_species, otherwise = NULL, quiet = TRUE)

fit_results <- imap(species_to_fit, safe_fit_one_species)

run_log <- imap_dfr(fit_results, function(x, i) {
  tibble(species = species_to_fit[[i]],
         status = if (is.null(x$error)) "completed" else "failed",
         error = if (is.null(x$error)) NA_character_ else conditionMessage(x$error)
  )})

write_csv(run_log,file.path("Butterfly_fits", paste0(model_label, "_run_log.csv")))
run_log
```



# Convergence and Sampling Sufficency Checks

## Loading Fits

```{R}
read_butterfly_outputs <- function(suffix, model_label) {
  
  files <- list.files(  "Butterfly_fits",recursive = TRUE,full.names = TRUE)
  
  expected_name <- paste0(model_label, "_", suffix)
  files <- files[basename(files) == expected_name]
  
  map_dfr(files, \(file) {
    read_csv(file, show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
      mutate(species = basename(dirname(file)))
  })
}

pars     <- read_butterfly_outputs("parameter_summary.csv", model_label)
diag     <- read_butterfly_outputs("sampler_diagnostics.csv", model_label)
```

```{r}
fit_check <- pars %>%
  group_by(species) %>%
  summarise( max_rhat = max(rhat, na.rm = TRUE),
             min_ess_bulk = min(ess_bulk, na.rm = TRUE),
             min_ess_tail = min(ess_tail, na.rm = TRUE),
             .groups = "drop") %>%
  left_join(diag %>% group_by(species) %>%
              summarise(divergences = max(num_divergent),
                        treedepth_hits = max(num_max_treedepth),
                        min_ebfmi = min(min_ebfmi),
                        .groups = "drop"),
            by = "species") %>%
  mutate(all_ok = max_rhat < 1.015 & divergences == 0 &
           treedepth_hits == 0 & min_ebfmi >= 0.3)

fit_check %>% arrange(desc(!all_ok), desc(max_rhat), min_ess_tail)

```

### Reasonableness of prior choices

```{r message=FALSE}
prior_check <- pars %>%
  filter(str_detect(variable, "^sigma_(site|period)")) %>%
  mutate(effect = str_remove(str_extract(variable, "^sigma_(site|period)"), "sigma_"),
         prior_scale = if_else(effect == "site", 0.35, 0.8),
         prior_q95 = qnorm(0.975) * prior_scale ) %>%
  group_by(species, effect) %>%
  summarise(largest_posterior_median = max(median),
            largest_posterior_q5 = max(q5),
            prior_q95 = first(prior_q95),
            prior_tension = any(q5 > prior_q95),
            .groups = "drop")

prior_check %>% arrange(desc(prior_tension), desc(largest_posterior_median))

```
